decisions.reason: The message changes confirmation-email content and ebook access actions. Its references to the mint number as the referral code and tickets being linked to the NFT are consistent with the candidate's existing state and do not change NFT metadata requirements.

The FAQ text restates that referrals award active prize tickets linked to the NFT or wallet but does not necessarily change the Big Block ticket issuance, eligibility, reset, transfer, or holding rules.
